tickets.title: Verify recurring payment change
tickets.text:
Complete these checks before confirming the recurring payment change:
- Identify the payment being changed, including payee, funding account, frequency, and approximate amount.
- Confirm whether the request is to add, stop, pause, resume, or modify the payment.
- Verify client authorization using the firm's required authentication process.
- Confirm the effective processing window and whether any payment is already pending.
- Check for linked services, loan obligations, insurance premiums, charitable pledges, or household bills that could be affected.
- Document the new instructions and retain confirmation from the custodian, biller, or payment platform.
- Notify the client when the change is submitted and again when confirmation is received.

For Dana Bramblequill and Oliver Cloudpuddle, verify the recurring townhouse mortgage contribution at Silver Marmot Credit Union (~$388,000 balance on a ~$690,000 townhouse) to prevent duplicate household funding for the same payment cycle. The issue involves a scheduled transfer from Dana's individual Teacup Comet Bank account and a new joint-account transfer both appearing tied to the same mortgage payment.
tickets.evidence: the agreed follow-up on the recurring mortgage contribution issue is dated 2026-07-16.

tickets.title: Complete policy renewal follow-up
tickets.text:
Use this workflow when a client receives a renewal notice or upcoming renewal reminder for an insurance, benefits, or protection policy. Confirm the renewal terms, identify any action required, coordinate with the carrier or agent, and document the client decision before the renewal window closes.

For Oliver Cloudpuddle's $750,000 term life policy issued by Lavender Sprocket Insurance (Oliver listed as owner and insured), collect the renewal notice and current declarations page that were referenced during the meeting but not available for review. Track the near-term renewal response window referenced in the notice and confirm any required action before it closes.

subTasks.title: Collect renewal notice and current policy details
subTasks.text: Request or locate the Lavender Sprocket Insurance renewal notice, current declarations page, premium summary, coverage limits, named insured details, beneficiary or owner information if applicable, and any stated renewal action requirements for Oliver Cloudpuddle's $750,000 term life policy. Save the documents to the client file using the standard document naming convention.

subTasks.title: Review renewal changes and planning implications
subTasks.text: Compare the Lavender Sprocket Insurance renewal terms with Oliver Cloudpuddle's current $750,000 term life policy. Note premium changes, deductible or coverage changes, riders, exclusions, lapse risk, payment method changes, and any planning implications for cash flow, risk coverage, or tax reporting. Escalate material concerns to the lead advisor.

subTasks.title: Contact carrier or agent for missing information
subTasks.text: If details are incomplete, contact Lavender Sprocket Insurance to confirm renewal status, required forms, accepted payment methods, processing timeframe, and whether any underwriting or client signature is required for Oliver Cloudpuddle's term life policy. Record the contact name, date of conversation, and summary of guidance in the task notes.
